thread:
pagerduty-bot: PAGERDUTY P1 -> eu-north-1: surge in 5xx and connection resets for surface-api-prod observed. Symptoms: ALB returns 502/504 intermittently, Route53 health-check for eu-north endpoints flapping, some EBS IO spikes. Estimated impact ~25% of EU traffic. Paging emma (oncall).

incident-bot: Automated triage: ALB target deregister spikes in eu-north-1b, ENI attach/detach errors logged, CloudWatch shows NAT Gateway connection table nearing capacity in one private subnet.

emma (oncall): I'm on. first action: confirm which AZs affected, check if weighted DNS has secondary region configured, and identify customer-facing sessions.

raj: telemetry shows eu-north-1b and eu-north-1c with the worst 5xxs. Route53 weighted records for api.prod.example currently: eu-north-1 weight=80, eu-west-2 weight=20. Healthcheck flaps started at 04:12 UTC.

nina: support reports ~200 errored requests across 60 sessions, 3 enterprise customers flagged. opening a temporary status banner.

emma (oncall): mitigation plan: (A) drop Route53 weight for eu-north-1 to 5 and shift remaining to eu-west-2; (B) cordon/drain instances showing EBS latency; (C) spin up extra NAT capacity; (D) request AWS ticket for ENI detach/attach failures. Executing DNS change now.

raj: Route53 change I'm pushing:

```bash
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z9EXAMPLE --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.prod.example.","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"eu-north-1","Weight":5,"TTL":30,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"ALB-eun1.example"}]}},{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.prod.example.","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"eu-west-2","Weight":95,"TTL":30,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"ALB-euw2.example"}]}}]}'
```

infra-bot: Route53 change submitted (change-id CDEF456). Propagation ~TTL=30s.

nina: status banner posted: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors for EU customers. Mitigation in progress."

emma (oncall): after weight shift, user-facing 5xx dropped from 25% -> ~9%. Still seeing some sessions with sticky affinity continuing to hit eu-north-1 and failing. We need to reduce stickiness TTL or evict sticky cookies.

raj: running router change to shorten session affinity TTL for the eu-north pool to 10s:

```bash
# router API
curl -X PATCH "https://router.internal/api/pools/eu-north" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"session_affinity_ttl":10}'
```

emma (oncall): done. that should reflow sticky sessions quickly.

infra-bot: ALB target group health: 6 targets unhealthy (ids: i-0aa1bb2c, i-0cc3dd4e, i-0ee5ff6a...). EBS read latency on i-0aa1bb2c spiked to 420ms. Syslog shows repeated NVME io timeouts.

raj: log excerpt from affected host:

```text
Apr 02 04:10:58 ip-10-0-3-21 kernel: nvme 0000:00:1f.2: I/O 1234567 timeout, admin_queue
Apr 02 04:11:03 ip-10-0-3-21 kubelet: Evicting pods: Node had disk pressure
Apr 02 04:11:20 ip-10-0-3-21 kubelet: Runtime network not ready: waiting for CNI
```

nina: support says one enterprise customer (FinX) on sticky session continues to see failures; offered them a dedicated temporary route to eu-west-2 if they want immediate failover.

emma (oncall): agreed. also manually cordoned two worst nodes and drained pods: kubectl drain i-0aa1bb2c. please ensure replacement nodes come up in eu-west-2 for critical pools.

infra-bot: Starting NAT gateway provisioning in eu-north-1b, creating nat-02f... and attaching EIP. Note: provisioning ~60s.

raj: AWS Support case created with ENI detach/attach and EBS IO anomalies (case #AWS-12345678). Asked for RC escalation.

emma (oncall): customers update queued. I'll hand off to raj for monitoring and customer comms in 15m. raj, you'll own post-mitigation checks and ensuring we keep reduced weight until AWS confirms region healthy.

raj: taking channel. current metrics: Route53 weight shift in effect, eu-north traffic down ~88%, 5xx rate for user-facing requests <5%. Backend EBS latency still elevated on three instances; AWS opened internal investigation.

nina: sent customers the update: "We have applied a temporary DNS shift to route most traffic away from eu-north-1 and are provisioning network and storage resources. We are tracking progress with AWS and will provide a full timeline and RCA."

infra-bot: Quick remediation suggestions logged: (1) add automated NAT autoscaler to provision extra NAT when conntrack > threshold, (2) add EBS IO per-AZ alert bucket, (3) reduce default session affinity TTL for weight-failover readiness.

emma (oncall): handoff: I'm stepping off at 4720001250 and handing to raj as primary. raj, please keep the channel open until AWS confirms it's safe to revert DNS. I'll stay on the AWS case if needed.

raj: acknowledged. setting incident status -> mitigated/monitoring. action items noted for postmortem.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigation applied (DNS weight shift & session-affinity reduction). Impact reduced from ~25% -> ~4% failing requests. AWS case open for ENI/EBS anomalies.

support: scheduling postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:00 UTC. drafting customer-facing timeline with initial mitigation and next steps.

raj: action items captured in incident tracker:
- AI-1: AWS RCA follow-up and case escalation (raj/emma)
- AI-2: NAT autoscaling design doc + implementation plan (infra)
- AI-3: Update routing playbook to include rapid affinity TTL override (platform)
- AI-4: Customer timeline + notifications (support)

nina: leaving channel open for 2h of stable health before closing. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
